nodes.title: Raw scan
nodes.description: The reformatted raw OCT volume (laterals × depth × frames) as loaded from the .OCT file. Every later stage is a rigid per-frame move of this data; no column is ever deformed.
nodes.method: The raw OCT volume (513 laterals × 640 depth × 101 frames, 0.0101 × 0.00313 × 0.040 mm) was reformatted to sagittal orientation without resampling.

nodes.title: Automatic corneal-surface detection (DP)
nodes.summary: dynamic-programming anterior surface on all 513 laterals
nodes.description: A despeckled, tissue-below-gated gradient is traced by dynamic programming into one smooth anterior path per sagittal slice; this is the baseline the reviewer's lines correct.
nodes.method: The anterior corneal surface was detected automatically on every sagittal slice by a dynamic-programming path through a despeckled tissue-gated gradient image.

nodes.title: Reviewer top-edge lines (original pane)
nodes.description: Polylines the reviewer drew on the raw sagittal slices marking the true anterior surface. They are pinned exactly and interpolated across the un-drawn slices.
nodes.method: A reviewer traced the anterior surface on 23 of 513 sagittal slices (917 points), which were pinned and interpolated across the remaining slices.

nodes.title: Surface-crop band / artifact bands / crop region
nodes.summary: surface-crop band frames 0..51 (manual); no artifact bands; no crop region
nodes.description: Frames the reviewer marked as clipped at the top of the canvas (the cornea runs off the image). These frames get their surface placed from thickness rather than detected.
nodes.method: Frames 0–51 were marked by the reviewer as anteriorly clipped (surface-crop band).

nodes.title: Served surface
nodes.summary: route: guided re-detect; drawn slices exact, others within ±1 px
nodes.description: The surface the reviewer saw and approved: the automatic baseline re-detected within a tight window of the drawn/interpolated lines, with drawn slices pinned exactly.
nodes.method: The final anterior surface was obtained by re-detecting the automatic surface within ±1 px of the reviewer-guided interpolation, with drawn slices pinned exactly.

nodes.title: Reviewer bottom lines
nodes.description: The posterior (endothelial) surface the reviewer drew on cropped frames so that thickness can place the top edge where it was clipped.
nodes.method: The posterior surface was traced by the reviewer on 3 sagittal slices to constrain corneal thickness inside the clipped band.

nodes.title: Top placement inside the band
nodes.description: Inside the clipped band the anterior surface is placed at the measured corneal thickness above the served posterior, using the flanking un-clipped frames as the thickness model.
nodes.method: Within the 52 clipped frames the anterior surface was placed at the flank-derived corneal thickness above the posterior surface.

nodes.title: Tissue-motion measurement
nodes.description: The per-frame rigid axial shift a[f] and tilt b[f] are measured from the tissue itself (A-scan correlation between neighbouring frames), independent of any surface trace.
nodes.method: Per-frame axial shift and tilt were measured from inter-frame A-scan correlation of the tissue (shift −12.3 to 9.8 px; maximum tilt 1.4 px).

nodes.status_reason: band bottom guide declined: drawn bottom lines cover 3 of 52 band frames (< 6 required)
nodes.title: Band bottom guide
nodes.summary: declined — too few bottom lines inside the band
nodes.description: When enough bottom lines exist inside the clipped band, the tissue-motion trajectory is guided by them; here there were too few, so the trajectory was kept as measured.
nodes.method: The band bottom guide was not applied (3 of 52 band frames had a drawn posterior line).

nodes.title: Canvas extension
nodes.summary: pad 160 px (640 → 800); reason: placed top above row 0
nodes.description: The depth canvas was extended upward so that the placed surface and the flatten move have room; no tissue is cut.
nodes.method: The depth axis was extended by 160 px (640 → 800) to accommodate the placed anterior surface.

nodes.title: Rigid per-frame flatten
nodes.summary: mode tissue; shift −54.5..88.1 px; tilt ≤ 2.1 px
nodes.description: Each frame is moved rigidly (one axial shift + one tilt) so that the served surface lands on a single smooth quadratic target across frames.
nodes.method: Each frame was shifted rigidly (−54.5 to 88.1 px) and tilted (≤ 2.1 px) so the anterior surface matched a smooth quadratic target.

nodes.status_reason: skipped on a cropped run: rigid_height_refine, rigid_frame_derotate, rigid_frame_refine
nodes.title: Detector-driven smoothing stages
nodes.description: The three detector-driven rigid smoothing stages are skipped when the surface inside the band was placed rather than detected.
nodes.method: Detector-driven refinement stages were skipped because the surface inside the clipped band was placed rather than detected.

nodes.title: Roughness veto
nodes.summary: waived (drawn edge on record); step guard held
nodes.description: Every roughness veto is waived when the reviewer drew the edge; the non-waivable tissue step guard still applies.
nodes.method: Roughness vetoes were waived because a reviewer-drawn edge was on record; the tissue step guard was retained.

nodes.status_reason: sagittal quad align is off by default on the corrections path
nodes.title: Sagittal quad align
nodes.description: A detector-driven sagittal quadratic alignment; off on the corrections path because it undoes the drawn-line flatten.
nodes.method: No sagittal quadratic alignment was applied.

nodes.title: Corrected-pane edits (line GT)
nodes.description: Edits drawn on the corrected result act as line ground truth for the flatten target.

nodes.title: Legacy edit transform
nodes.description: A stored per-frame shift+tilt learned from corrected-pane edits, applied last.

nodes.title: Corrected volume
nodes.description: The corrected volume written for the next stage (SAM2 cornea segmentation).
nodes.method: The corrected volume (513 × 800 × 101) had a residual anterior-surface deviation of 2.8 px from the quadratic target.
